_comment: API-Football (api-sports.io / RapidAPI) config for TEAM-level schedules only. api_key: get one free at https://dashboard.api-football.com (direct) or via RapidAPI. auth_style: 'direct' uses x-apisports-key + v3.football.api-sports.io; 'rapidapi' uses x-rapidapi-key/host + api-football-v1.p.rapidapi.com - switch both auth_style and base_url together if you signed up via RapidAPI instead. league_id: null means 'look it up by name and cache it' - only Premier League and Championship IDs are confirmed, League One/Two resolve automatically on first run.
